items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I don't know why they called him Yardbird. But that boy played so much horn... maybe they called him Yardbird because he played trombone almost like the -- maybe they called him Yardbird because he played trombone almost like Parker would play the saxophone.

ctx.x: Yeah, I don't know why they called him Yardbird. But that boy played so much horn, oh, he played trombone -- he played a trombone almost like the -- maybe they called him Yardbird because he played trombone almost like Parker would play the saxophone. Yeah, he played so much trombone.
This was earlier. This was before Charlie was -- Charlie was just a kid.
